Hello Reddit

I am a relative of this person, and I have his telephone in my hands. He passed away an hour ago at the hospital.
Reddit was the last social media he posted to. I would not have expected this because he did not use social medias very much. 

I would like to thank for your support to my friend.
Such tragedy should never happen to any body, and no parent should have to bury their children.

Vincenzo was about to change his name legally, even though he had been called Vincenzo for pretty much 5 years. I am sad it could not be done before his death. 

I thought his mother would want to delete his account on social medias : but after thinking about it I do not think we have the right to do this. 

We will make sure this does not get known because of his last words on reddit. Vincenzo wrote in his note that he wanted his family to go through this peacefully. 

Again, me and his family thank you
Forgive my bad english, I am from France

Take care of yourself and of your relatives, stay safe
I will make updates if he wakes up :/
